label: preparing
what: A surprise jubilee/tribute celebration for the mayor in the great hall on day 1 at 18:00, with 200 replacement fresh feast loaves distributed among four table chests, eight hall lanterns, funding and discreet escort arrangements. Innkeeper, freight and builder coordinated; baker knowingly supplied confidential catering. Secretary helped schedule the gathering and escort and agreed to ordinary catering discretion, but is not shown knowing the jubilee/tribute purpose and refused to conceal spending requiring mayoral approval. Mayor was told of a generic community gathering and approved attendance, not shown being told its surprise tribute purpose. Neighbour overheard information but is not shown knowingly helping preparations.
